subject: CoachBone integrator lab and onboarding coordination
messages:
From: Liam O'Reilly <liam@coachbone.consulting>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Aug 2029 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: CoachBone + Redwood integrator lab and enablement

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the intro with Redwood — excited to get our team through the integrator enablement. We recently signed an MSA with SummitBridge and need a 2-week technical onboarding for our SI engineers so we can start delivering client pilots.

High level ask: a half-day integrator lab (hands-on) + two 1-hour follow-up Q&A sessions. Key constraints: time zone preference US PST mornings, and a lightweight sandbox we can use that doesn't require PII.

I copied Rishi for technical alignment. Can you confirm next steps and what materials you need from our side?

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Reilly
Head of Integrations, CoachBone Consulting
liam@coachbone.consulting

Hi Liam — welcome, and congrats on the MSA.

We can run a practical integrator lab and pair it with a short enablement playbook. Attached is a proposed half-day agenda and the integrator environment checklist.

Proposed next steps:
- You: confirm preferred dates (two options) and list of 6 engineers who will attend.
- Us: reserve lab slots, prepare a pre-configured sandbox (no PII), and share the workshop repo.
- Rishi/Jonas: technical pre-check (see note below).

Attachments: coachbone_onboarding_agenda.pdf, integrator_env_checklist.xlsx

Thanks — I can run the kickoff and provide the workshop materials; Jonas will lead the hands-on lab.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Partner Programs Manager | Redwood Inference

Thanks Hannah. A few technical notes from the runtime/ops side:

- Sandbox: we'll provide a pre-provisioned Redwood demo pool (quantized model variant) that allows live inference without uploading customer data. Good for lab tasks and performance checks.
- Network: if CoachBone prefers VPC peering for a dedicated test, we need an IP range and a contact for networking.
- Data: please confirm no PII datasets will be used — use synthetic prompts or redacted exports.
- Slots: mornings PST on Sep 10 or Sep 12 look open from our side (0900-1300).

I'll add a small checklist for the lab runbook and a short script we use to seed KV cache to keep latency consistent.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
